findings: The book says memory B cells are members of the plasma-cell clone that do not make antibodies; they are usually described as arising from activated B cells alongside plasma cells. The lesson notes this, flagged.

'Raher' is read as Rather and 'George Kohler' as Georges Kohler. The inducer and suppressor T cell roles follow the book's older classification. The boxes on vaccines, plasma protein and gene therapy are carried.
